name: Imperial I-class Star Destroyer
description: The Imperial I-class Star Destroyer was a model of Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Imperial Navy. A wedge-shaped capital ship, it bristled with weapons emplacements, assault troops, boarding craft, and TIE fighters. At 1.6km long, it was the signature vessel of the Imperial fleet and represented the might of the Empire throughout the galaxy.

name: Executor-class Super Star Destroyer
description: The Executor-class Star Dreadnought, also known as the Executor-class Super Star Destroyer or simply Super Star Destroyer, was a class of massive capital ships built by the Galactic Empire. At 19 kilometers long, the Executor was the largest traditional starship constructed by the Imperial Navy.

name: Millennium Falcon
description: The Millennium Falcon was a YT-1300 light freighter that became famous as the personal starship of Han Solo and Chewbacca. Despite its aged appearance and numerous modifications, the Falcon was one of the fastest ships in the galaxy, famously making the Kessel Run in less than twelve parsecs.

name: X-Wing Starfighter
description: The T-65B X-wing starfighter was the primary all-purpose starfighter of the Rebel Alliance and its successor governments. Known for its versatility and exceptional combat performance, the X-wing became a symbol of the Rebellion's fight against the Empire.

name: TIE Fighter
description: The TIE/ln space superiority starfighter, commonly known as the TIE fighter, was the signature starfighter of the Galactic Empire. Known for its distinctive howl when flying and twin ion engines, it was fast, agile, and produced in massive numbers.

name: Slave I
description: Slave I was a modified Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft used by the infamous bounty hunters Jango Fett and later his cloned son Boba Fett. The ship was heavily modified with advanced weaponry, stealth systems, and a distinctive vertical flight orientation.

name: Death Star
description: The DS-1 Orbital Battle Station, commonly known as the Death Star, was the Galactic Empire's monstrous deep-space mobile battle station. At 160km in diameter, it was armed with a superlaser capable of destroying entire planets.

name: Venator-class Star Destroyer
description: The Venator-class Star Destroyer, also known as the Republic attack cruiser, was the primary capital ship of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. It served as both a warship and carrier for the Republic's clone trooper forces.

name: Home One
description: Home One, also known as the Headquarters Frigate, was an MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser that served as the flagship of the Rebel Alliance fleet. It was Admiral Ackbar's personal command ship during the Battle of Endor.

name: Razor Crest
description: The Razor Crest was an ST-70 class Razor Crest M-111 Assault Ship used by the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin. It served as his personal transport and living quarters during his bounty hunting career.

name: Ghost
description: The Ghost was a modified VCX-100 light freighter owned by the Twi'lek Hera Syndulla and used by the Spectres rebel cell during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

name: Nebulon-B Frigate
description: The EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate was a capital ship used by the Imperial Navy and later the Rebel Alliance. Its distinctive spindly shape made it instantly recognizable, and it served various roles including medical transport and escort duty.

name: A-Wing Starfighter
description: The RZ-1 A-wing interceptor was a wedge-shaped starfighter used by the Rebel Alliance. It was the fastest starfighter in the Alliance fleet, designed for hit-and-run attacks and intercepting enemy craft.

name: B-Wing Starfighter
description: The A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter was a heavy assault starfighter used by the Rebel Alliance. Its distinctive gyroscopic cockpit allowed it to maintain orientation while the rest of the ship rotated around it.

name: Y-Wing Starfighter
description: The BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber was a bomber used by the Rebel Alliance. Though older and slower than other starfighters, its durability and heavy weapons load made it a reliable ground-attack craft.

name: TIE Advanced x1
description: The TIE Advanced x1 was a prototype starfighter used by Darth Vader at the Battle of Yavin. It featured a hyperdrive and deflector shields, unlike standard TIE fighters.

name: Imperial Shuttle
description: The Lambda-class T-4a shuttle was a standard Imperial transport used to ferry officers and dignitaries. Its distinctive tri-wing design made it one of the most recognizable shuttles in the galaxy.

name: Blockade Runner
description: The CR90 corvette, commonly known as the Blockade Runner, was a small, fast capital ship used by the Rebel Alliance. Princess Leia's Tantive IV was perhaps the most famous example.

name: Separatist Dreadnought
description: The Providence-class Dreadnought was a capital ship used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. General Grievous's flagship, the Invisible Hand, was a modified version of this class.

name: ARC-170 Starfighter
description: The ARC-170 starfighter was a heavy starfighter used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. It featured an astromech droid socket and was crewed by a pilot, navigator, and tail gunner.

name: USS Enterprise NCC-1701-D
description: The USS Enterprise NCC-1701-D was a Galaxy-class starship and the flagship of the United Federation of Planets. Under the command of Captain Jean-Luc Picard, it conducted exploration and diplomatic missions throughout the Alpha Quadrant.

name: USS Enterprise NCC-1701
description: The USS Enterprise NCC-1701 was a Constitution-class heavy cruiser that became legendary under the command of Captain James T. Kirk. It conducted the five-year mission of exploration from 2265 to 2270.

name: USS Voyager NCC-74656
description: The USS Voyager was an Intrepid-class starship stranded in the Delta Quadrant by the Caretaker entity. Under Captain Kathryn Janeway, it undertook a 75-year journey home through uncharted space.

name: USS Defiant NX-74205
description: The USS Defiant was a prototype warship designed to fight the Borg. Assigned to Deep Space 9 under Captain Benjamin Sisko, it became one of the most powerful ships in the Federation fleet.

name: Borg Cube
description: The Borg cube was the primary starship of the Borg Collective. At 3km on each side, these massive vessels were capable of assimilating entire worlds and were nearly impervious to conventional weapons.

name: Klingon Bird-of-Prey
description: The Klingon Bird-of-Prey was a versatile warship used by both the Klingon Empire and Romulan Star Empire. Its distinctive wing design allowed for variable geometry configurations.

name: Romulan Warbird
description: The D'deridex-class warbird was the primary capital ship of the Romulan Star Empire. Its distinctive green color and massive size made it one of the most feared vessels in the Alpha Quadrant.

name: USS Enterprise NCC-1701-E
description: The USS Enterprise-E was a Sovereign-class starship and successor to the Enterprise-D. Under Captain Picard, it defended the Federation against the Borg and other threats.

name: Deep Space 9
description: Deep Space 9 was a Cardassian space station converted for Federation use. Located near the Bajoran wormhole, it became a crucial strategic outpost and center of commerce and diplomacy.

name: USS Discovery NCC-1031
description: The USS Discovery was a Crossfield-class science vessel equipped with an experimental spore drive, allowing it to jump instantly across vast distances of space.

name: USS Enterprise NCC-1701-A
description: The USS Enterprise-A was a Constitution-class refit starship given to Captain Kirk's crew after the destruction of the original Enterprise. It served in the late 23rd century.

name: Ferengi Marauder
description: The D'Kora-class marauder was the primary starship of the Ferengi Alliance. Designed for both commerce and combat, it was heavily armed for a vessel of its size.

name: Jem'Hadar Attack Ship
description: The Jem'Hadar attack ship was the primary small craft of the Dominion. These heavily armed vessels were crewed by Jem'Hadar soldiers and could take on much larger opponents.

name: Cardassian Galor-class
description: The Galor-class was the primary warship of the Cardassian Union. Its distinctive spoon-shaped hull made it one of the most recognizable vessels in the Alpha Quadrant.

name: Vulcan D'Kyr
description: The D'Kyr-class was a Vulcan science vessel used for both scientific research and diplomatic missions. Its distinctive ring-shaped warp drive was a hallmark of Vulcan design.

name: USS Cerritos NCC-75567
description: The USS Cerritos was a California-class support vessel assigned to second contact missions. Under Captain Carol Freeman, its crew handled the less glamorous but essential tasks of Starfleet operations.

name: Battlestar Galactica
description: The Battlestar Galactica was a Jupiter-class battlestar and one of the oldest ships in the Colonial Fleet. Under Commander Adama, it survived the Cylon attack and led the fleet of survivors to Earth.

name: Battlestar Pegasus
description: The Battlestar Pegasus was a Mercury-class battlestar under the command of Admiral Helena Cain. More advanced than Galactica, it was a formidable warship that survived the Cylon attack on the Colonies.

name: Colonial Viper Mk II
description: The Viper Mark II was the primary space superiority fighter of the Colonial Military during the First Cylon War. Though obsolete by the time of the Fall, it remained a capable fighter in the right hands.

name: Cylon Basestar
description: The Basestar was the primary capital ship of the Cylon fleet. Unlike Colonial battlestars, basestars were partially organic and carried massive numbers of Raiders for fighter combat.

name: Cylon Raider
description: The Cylon Raider was the primary fighter craft of the Cylon fleet. The modern version was a bio-mechanical craft that was partially alive and could be resurrected after destruction.

name: Colonial Raptor
description: The Raptor was a multi-role support craft used by the Colonial Fleet. It served as a scout, electronic warfare platform, transport, and bomber, making it one of the most versatile craft in the fleet.

name: SSV Normandy SR-1
description: The SSV Normandy SR-1 was a Systems Alliance frigate and prototype stealth reconnaissance ship. Under Commander Shepard, it became the most advanced ship in the Alliance fleet.

name: Normandy SR-2
description: The Normandy SR-2 was a larger, more advanced successor to the SR-1. Built by Cerberus and later returned to Alliance service, it served as Commander Shepard's command vessel against the Reapers.

name: Reaper Destroyer
description: Reaper Destroyers were mid-sized Reaper capital ships, smaller than Sovereign-class vessels but still capable of devastating entire cities. They served as the primary ground assault craft of the Reaper fleet.

name: Reaper Sovereign
description: Sovereign was a Reaper vanguard left behind to monitor the galaxy and initiate the next cycle of extinction. It could indoctrinate organic minds and was nearly indestructible by conventional means.

name: Citadel
description: The Citadel was a massive space station that served as the political, cultural, and financial capital of the galaxy. It was actually a dormant mass relay designed to summon the Reapers.

name: Alliance Cruiser
description: Systems Alliance cruisers were the backbone of the Alliance Navy. Armed with mass accelerator cannons, they were capable of engaging much larger vessels through coordinated tactics.

name: Destiny Ascension
description: The Destiny Ascension was the flagship of the Citadel Fleet and the most powerful warship in the galaxy. An asari dreadnought, it served as the personal vessel of the Citadel Council.

name: Geth Dreadnought
description: The Geth Dreadnought was a massive geth warship that served as a server hub for millions of geth programs. It was one of the largest vessels constructed by the geth collective.

name: Quarian Liveship
description: Quarian Liveships were massive agricultural vessels that sustained the Migrant Fleet. They were the most important ships in the flotilla, carrying the majority of the quarian population.

name: Collector Cruiser
description: The Collector Cruiser was the primary vessel of the Collectors, a mysterious race that abducted human colonists. It was actually a modified Prothean vessel repurposed by the Reapers.

name: UNSC Pillar of Autumn
description: The UNSC Pillar of Autumn was a Halcyon-class light cruiser that served as Master Chief's escape vessel from Reach. It carried the last Spartan-II and an AI named Cortana to Installation 04.

name: UNSC Infinity
description: The UNSC Infinity was the largest and most advanced vessel in the UNSC Navy. Equipped with Forerunner technology, it served as the flagship of the UNSC fleet and a training vessel for Spartan-IVs.

name: UNSC Forward Unto Dawn
description: The UNSC Forward Unto Dawn was a Charon-class light frigate that served alongside the Master Chief during the Battle of Earth and the Ark campaign. Its aft section was lost in space for years.

name: Covenant Assault Carrier
description: The CAS-class assault carrier was one of the largest vessels in the Covenant fleet. These massive ships served as flagships for Covenant fleets and could carry thousands of warriors.

name: Covenant Battlecruiser
description: The CCS-class battlecruiser was the primary capital ship of the Covenant fleet. Its distinctive teardrop shape and powerful energy projectors made it a feared opponent.

name: Seraph
description: The Type-31 Seraph was the primary exoatmospheric fighter of the Covenant. Fast and heavily armed, it was a match for most UNSC fighters despite being less maneuverable.

name: Banshee
description: The Type-26 Banshee was the primary ground support aircraft of the Covenant. Its distinctive wail and plasma cannons made it a terror to ground forces.

name: Longsword
description: The GA-TL1 Longsword was the primary space superiority fighter of the UNSC Navy. Large and heavily armed, it could carry nuclear weapons and engage multiple targets simultaneously.

name: Pelican
description: The D77-TC Pelican was the primary dropship of the UNSC. Capable of carrying troops, vehicles, and cargo, it was the workhorse of the UNSC military.

name: Phantom
description: The Type-52 Phantom was the primary dropship of the Covenant. Heavily armed and armored, it could carry a full lance of Covenant warriors into battle.

name: Forerunner Keyship
description: Forerunner Keyships were massive vessels used to activate the Halo Array and transport life between worlds. The Prophet of Truth attempted to use one to activate the Ark.

name: USCSS Nostromo
description: The USCSS Nostromo was a Lockmart CM-88B Bison M-Class star freighter owned by the Weyland-Yutani Corporation. Its ill-fated voyage in 2122 led to humanity's first encounter with the Xenomorph species.

name: USS Sulaco
description: The USS Sulaco was a Conestoga-class troop transport used by the United States Colonial Marine Corps. It carried the ill-fated mission to LV-426 to investigate the loss of contact with Hadley's Hope colony.

name: USCSS Covenant
description: The USCSS Covenant was a colony ship on a mission to colonize Origae-6. Its crew discovered the planet LV-223, leading to a disastrous encounter with David's experiments.

name: USCSS Prometheus
description: The USCSS Prometheus was a scientific exploration vessel sent to LV-223 to investigate signs of alien life. Its crew discovered the Engineers and the black liquid that would create the Xenomorph species.

name: The Betty
description: The Betty was an unregistered smuggling vessel captained by Elgyn. Its crew of mercenaries was hired to deliver kidnapped humans to the USM Auriga for Xenomorph experiments.

name: Engineer Juggernaut
description: The Juggernaut was an Engineer spacecraft designed to carry biological weapons. The derelict on LV-426 was one such vessel, carrying Xenomorph eggs that would change human history.

name: BC-304 Daedalus
description: The BC-304 Daedalus was Earth's first deep-space carrier equipped with Asgard technology. It served as the primary defense vessel for Earth and support craft for the Atlantis expedition.

name: Ha'tak
description: The Ha'tak was the primary capital ship of the Goa'uld Empire. Its distinctive pyramid shape and golden hull made it a symbol of Goa'uld power throughout the galaxy.

name: Aurora-class Battleship
description: The Aurora-class battleship was a warship used by the Lanteans in their war against the Wraith. One of the most powerful vessels ever built, it could take on multiple Hive ships.

name: Wraith Hive Ship
description: Wraith Hive ships were massive organic vessels that served as the primary warships and mobile bases of the Wraith. Grown rather than built, they were among the largest ships in the Pegasus Galaxy.

name: Ori Warship
description: Ori warships were the primary vessels of the Ori crusade. Equipped with powerful energy weapons and Ori shields, they were nearly invincible against conventional forces.

name: Puddle Jumper
description: The Puddle Jumper was a small Ancient vessel designed to fit through Stargates. Used extensively by the Atlantis expedition, it was equipped with Ancient technology including cloaking and drones.

name: Destiny
description: Destiny was an Ancient spacecraft launched millions of years ago to explore the universe. A team from Earth became stranded aboard it, forced to follow its automated mission through the far reaches of space.

name: F-302 Fighter
description: The F-302 was Earth's first operational space superiority fighter. Based on Goa'uld and Ancient technology, it could operate both in atmosphere and deep space.

name: Al'kesh
description: The Al'kesh was a Goa'uld mid-range bomber used for both atmospheric and space combat. Smaller than a Ha'tak but heavily armed, it was a versatile craft used by many Goa'uld System Lords.

name: Asgard O'Neill-class
description: The O'Neill-class was the most advanced warship ever built by the Asgard. Named after Jack O'Neill, it represented the pinnacle of Asgard technology before their extinction.

name: Rocinante
description: The Rocinante was a former MCRN Corvette-class light frigate, later commandeered by James Holden and his crew. It became one of the most important vessels in human history.

name: Donnager
description: The MCRN Donnager was the flagship of the Martian Congressional Republic Navy. A Donnager-class battleship, it was one of the largest and most powerful ships in the solar system.

name: Canterbury
description: The Canterbury was a Pur'n'Kleen Water Company ice hauler that supplied water to the Belt. Its destruction by a stealth ship triggered the events that led to the UN-MCR War.

name: Nauvoo
description: The LDSS Nauvoo was a massive generation ship built for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Later renamed the Behemoth and then Medina Station, it was the largest ship ever built by humanity.

name: Razorback
description: The Razorback was a high-speed racing pinnace owned by Julie Mao. One of the fastest ships in the solar system, it was later used by the Rocinante crew for various missions.

name: Anubis
description: The Anubis was a Protogen stealth ship of the Amun-Ra-class. It carried the protomolecule to Phoebe Station and later infected Eros, triggering the protomolecule crisis.

name: Scirocco
description: The MCRN Scirocco was a Scirocco-class assault cruiser of the Martian Congressional Republic Navy. It served as a fleet command vessel during the UN-MCR Cold War.

name: Agatha King
description: The UNN Agatha King was a Truman-class dreadnought of the United Nations Navy. It served during the UN-MCR War and was involved in the Io campaign.

name: Imperial Retribution-class Battleship
description: The Retribution-class Battleship was one of the largest warships in the Imperial Navy. At 8km long, it was a symbol of the Emperor's wrath, capable of leveling entire continents from orbit.

name: Emperor-class Battleship
description: The Emperor-class Battleship was a massive carrier-battleship hybrid used by the Imperial Navy. It carried thousands of attack craft and enough firepower to destroy entire fleets.

name: Lunar-class Cruiser
description: The Lunar-class Cruiser was the most common capital ship in the Imperial Navy. Reliable and versatile, it formed the backbone of Battlefleet Gothic and countless other sector fleets.

name: Gloriana-class Battleship
description: The Gloriana-class Battleship was a massive vessel used as flagships by the Primarchs during the Great Crusade. Each Legion had its own unique design, tailored to their combat doctrine.

name: Chaos Despoiler-class
description: The Despoiler-class Battleship was the largest vessel in the Chaos fleet. Often serving as flagships for Chaos Lords, these corrupted vessels were nightmares given form.

name: Aeldari Craftworld
description: Craftworlds were planetoid-sized worldships that housed the remnants of the Aeldari civilization. Each Craftworld was millions of kilometers in size, carrying billions of souls.

name: Necron Cairn-class Tomb Ship
description: The Cairn-class Tomb Ship was the primary capital ship of the Necron fleet. Made of living metal and armed with weapons that could strip targets atom by atom, it was nearly indestructible.

name: Ork Kill Kroozer
description: The Kill Kroozer was the primary warship of Ork pirate fleets. Built from salvaged hulks and scrap, these ramshackle vessels were surprisingly effective in combat.

name: Tyranid Hive Ship
description: Hive Ships were massive bio-ships that served as the primary vessels of Tyranid hive fleets. Grown rather than built, they carried millions of organisms and consumed entire worlds.

name: Tau Explorer-class
description: The Explorer-class was the largest vessel in the Tau fleet, designed for long-range exploration and expansion. It carried entire colonies and served as mobile command centers.

name: Guild Heighliner
description: Guild Heighliners were massive starships used by the Spacing Guild to transport people and cargo across the known universe. At 20km long, they could fold space to travel instantaneously.

name: Hunter-Seeker
description: The Hunter-Seeker was a small, floating assassination device used by House Harkonnen. Suspended by a Holtzman field, it could seek out and kill targets with a poisoned needle.

name: ornithopter
description: Ornithopters were winged aircraft used for atmospheric flight on Arrakis. They flapped their wings like birds and were the primary mode of transportation on the desert planet.

name: Babylon 5 Station
description: Babylon 5 was the last of the Babylon stations, a five-mile-long space station designed to foster peace and diplomacy among the races of the galaxy. It was the last, best hope for peace.

name: Omega-class Destroyer
description: The Omega-class Destroyer was the primary warship of the Earth Alliance. At 1.7km long, it combined heavy firepower with fighter carrying capacity, making it a versatile combat vessel.

name: White Star
description: The White Star was a prototype vessel combining Minbari and Vorlon technology. Used by the Rangers and the Army of Light, it was one of the most advanced ships of its time.

name: Sharlin-class Warcruiser
description: The Sharlin-class Warcruiser was the primary capital ship of the Minbari Federation. Its advanced stealth technology and powerful weapons made it nearly unbeatable in combat.

name: Shadow Battlecrab
description: Shadow Battlecrabs were the primary warships of the Shadows. These organic vessels could phase in and out of hyperspace and carried devastating weaponry.

name: Vorlon Dreadnought
description: Vorlon Dreadnoughts were massive organic vessels used by the Vorlon Empire. Their advanced technology and powerful weapons made them among the most feared ships in the galaxy.

name: Starfury
description: The Starfury was the primary space superiority fighter of the Earth Alliance. Its unique design allowed for exceptional maneuverability in zero-gravity combat.

name: Narn G'Quan Cruiser
description: The G'Quan-class heavy cruiser was the primary capital ship of the Narn Regime. Built with help from the Centauri, it was a symbol of Narn independence and strength.

name: USG Ishimura
description: The USG Ishimura was a Planet Cracker-class mining vessel and the flagship of the Concordance Extraction Corporation. Its discovery of the Red Marker on Aegis VII led to the Necromorph outbreak.

name: USG Kellion
description: The USG Kellion was a small repair shuttle dispatched to the USG Ishimura to investigate a communications blackout. It carried Isaac Clarke and the team that would face the Necromorph horrors.

name: USM Valor
description: The USM Valor was an EarthGov destroyer dispatched to retrieve the Red Marker from the Ishimura. It was destroyed after a Necromorph outbreak was triggered aboard.

name: Terra Nova
description: The SCAF Terra Nova was a Sovereign Colonies Armed Forces colony ship that participated in the expedition to Tau Volantis. It later became a derelict haunted by Necromorphs.

name: Hyperion
description: The Hyperion was a Behemoth-class battlecruiser and the flagship of Raynor's Raiders. Under Jim Raynor's command, it became a symbol of resistance against the Dominion.

name: Terran Battlecruiser
description: The Behemoth-class battlecruiser was the primary capital ship of the Terran Dominion. Armed with Yamato cannons and laser batteries, it was a formidable warship.

name: Protoss Carrier
description: The Carrier was the primary capital ship of the Protoss fleet. It carried squadrons of robotic Interceptors and was a symbol of Protoss technological superiority.

name: Void Ray
description: The Void Ray was a Protoss siege craft that channeled Void energy through prismatic beams. It was particularly effective against heavily armored targets.

name: Zerg Leviathan
description: The Leviathan was a massive Zerg bio-ship that served as a command vessel and troop transport. Grown from genetically modified space creatures, it could travel through warp space.

name: Wraith
description: The Wraith was a Terran space superiority fighter. Equipped with cloaking technology and air-to-air missiles, it was the primary fighter of the Terran military.

name: Mutalisk
description: The Mutalisk was a Zerg flying unit that attacked with glaive wurms. These bat-like creatures were the primary air force of the Zerg Swarm.

name: Scout
description: The Scout was a Protoss fighter used for reconnaissance and air superiority. Fast and agile, it was effective against both air and ground targets.

name: Serenity
description: Serenity was a Firefly-class transport ship captained by Malcolm Reynolds. Named after the Battle of Serenity Valley, it was home to a crew of smugglers and fugitives trying to make their way in the 'Verse.

name: Reaver Ship
description: Reaver ships were vessels captured and modified by the Reavers, savage raiders who lurked at the edge of known space. Covered in blood and bones, they were a terror to all who encountered them.

name: Avatar-class Titan
description: The Avatar was the Amarr Empire's titan-class vessel. At nearly 15km long, it could mount doomsday weapons and create jump bridges for entire fleets.

name: Leviathan-class Titan
description: The Leviathan was the Caldari State's titan-class vessel. At over 18km long, it was the largest vessel in the Caldari fleet and could devastate entire fleets with its doomsday weapon.

name: Ragnarok-class Titan
description: The Ragnarok was the Minmatar Republic's titan-class vessel. At over 18km long, it combined massive firepower with the Minmatar's signature rugged design.

name: Erebus-class Titan
description: The Erebus was the Gallente Federation's titan-class vessel. At nearly 15km long, it was a symbol of Gallente military might and democratic values.

name: Moros-class Dreadnought
description: The Moros was the Gallente Federation's dreadnought-class vessel. At over 3km long, it could enter siege mode to deal devastating damage to structures and capital ships.

name: Widow-class Black Ops
description: The Widow was a Caldari Black Ops battleship designed for covert operations. It could use a jump portal to transport entire covert fleets behind enemy lines.

name: Rifter-class Frigate
description: The Rifter was a Minmatar frigate known for its speed and versatility. A favorite of new pilots and veterans alike, it was one of the most iconic ships in New Eden.

name: Hive Dreadnaught
description: The Dreadnaught was Oryx's personal vessel, carved from the corpse of the Worm God Akka. At 25km long, it was a throne world in physical space and home to the Taken.

name: Leviathan
description: The Leviathan was Emperor Calus's massive world-eating ship. At 120km in diameter, it consumed planets and processed them into royal wine for the Cabal Emperor.

name: The Traveler
description: The Traveler was a mysterious paracausal entity that granted humanity the Light and the power of the Guardians. At 14km in diameter, it hovered above the Last City.

name: Arcadia-class Jumpship
description: The Arcadia-class jumpship was a common personal spacecraft used by Guardians. Fast and maneuverable, it was the primary means of travel for Guardians throughout the solar system.

name: Ketch
description: The Ketch was a Fallen warship used by various Eliksni houses. These vessels served as mobile bases for Fallen pirates and scavengers throughout the system.

name: TCS Tiger's Claw
description: The TCS Tiger's Claw was a Bengal-class strike carrier and the pride of the Terran Confederation fleet. Under Colonel Blair's command, it turned the tide of the Kilrathi War.

name: Rapier II
description: The F-44 Rapier II was the premier medium fighter of the Terran Confederation. Fast, well-armed, and heavily shielded, it was a match for any Kilrathi fighter.

name: Hornet
description: The CF-117 Hornet was a light fighter used by the Terran Confederation. Though lightly armed, its speed and agility made it an effective interceptor.

name: Dralthi
description: The Dralthi was the primary light fighter of the Kilrathi Empire. Its distinctive crescent shape and mass drivers made it a dangerous opponent in the hands of skilled pilots.

name: Anaconda
description: The Anaconda was a versatile heavy ship manufactured by Faulcon DeLacy. Capable of exploration, combat, and trading, it was a favorite of experienced pilots.

name: Cobra Mk III
description: The Cobra Mk III was a classic multirole ship that had been in production for centuries. Its versatility and affordability made it one of the most popular ships in the galaxy.

name: Sidewinder Mk I
description: The Sidewinder was the standard starter ship for new pilots. Cheap and easy to maintain, it was the first step on every commander's journey.

name: Federal Corvette
description: The Federal Corvette was a heavy combat vessel available only to officers of the Federation. Heavily armed and armored, it was one of the most powerful combat ships available.

name: Imperial Cutter
description: The Imperial Cutter was the largest ship available from the Empire. A symbol of wealth and status, it was used by Imperial nobility for both trade and combat.

name: Asp Explorer
description: The Asp Explorer was a medium exploration vessel manufactured by Lakon Spaceways. Its excellent jump range and view from the cockpit made it a favorite of explorers.

name: Krait Mk II
description: The Krait Mk II was a medium multirole vessel based on a classic design. It could carry a fighter bay while maintaining excellent combat capabilities.

name: Type-9 Heavy
description: The Type-9 Heavy was a massive freighter used for bulk trading. Its enormous cargo capacity made it the workhorse of galactic commerce.

name: The Ark
description: The Ark was the spacecraft that carried the Autobots from Cybertron to Earth. It crash-landed on Earth millions of years ago, with its occupants remaining in stasis until 1984.

name: Nemesis
description: The Nemesis was the Decepticon flagship commanded by Megatron. At over 4km long, it was one of the largest ships ever built on Cybertron, designed to raze entire planets.

name: Axalon
description: The Axalon was a Maximal exploration vessel commanded by Optimus Primal. It pursued the Predacon criminal Megatron through transwarp space to prehistoric Earth.

name: Darkmount
description: Darkmount was a massive Decepticon fortress on Cybertron. Capable of transforming into a mobile battle station, it was a symbol of Decepticon military might.

name: Samus's Gunship
description: Samus Aran's Gunship was her personal spacecraft and mobile base. Equipped with advanced Chozo technology, it served as her home between missions.

name: GFS Olympus
description: The GFS Olympus was the flagship of the Galactic Federation fleet. An Olympus-class battleship, it served as Admiral Dane's command vessel during the Phazon crisis.

name: Space Pirate Mothership
description: The Space Pirate Mothership was the command vessel of the Space Pirate forces. It served as the base of operations for their raids on Federation space.

name: TARDIS
description: The TARDIS (Time And Relative Dimension In Space) was the Doctor's time machine. Disguised as a 1960s police box, it was dimensionally transcendental - bigger on the inside.

name: Dalek Saucer
description: Dalek Saucers were the primary spacecraft of the Dalek Empire. These flying discs carried hundreds of Daleks and enough firepower to destroy entire planets.

name: Sontaran Mothership
description: Sontaran Motherships were massive vessels used by the Sontaran Empire. These warships carried thousands of clone warriors to battle across space and time.

name: Cyberman Ship
description: Cyberman ships were the vessels used by the Cybermen in their campaigns of conversion. These cold, efficient vessels reflected the nature of their cybernetic crew.

name: Radiant Pillar BC1
description: The Radiant Pillar BC1 was the starting ship for many travelers. A reliable fighter-class vessel, it served explorers well in their first journeys across the galaxy.

name: Sentinel Interceptor
description: Sentinel Interceptors were organic ships created by the Sentinel forces. These biomechanical vessels could be recovered and piloted by travelers who proved themselves worthy.

name: Living Ship
description: Living Ships were organic spacecraft grown from Void Eggs. These biological vessels required different maintenance than mechanical ships and had unique abilities.

name: Hearthian Ship
description: The Hearthian Ship was a primitive spacecraft built by the Hearthians using wood and salvaged technology. Despite its humble origins, it was capable of exploring the entire solar system.

name: Nomai Vessel
description: The Nomai Vessel was a massive spacecraft that brought the Nomai to the Hearthian solar system. Its warp technology allowed instantaneous travel across vast distances.

name: Stranger
description: The Stranger was a massive rotating ringworld built by the Owlks to escape the supernova. It contained a virtual reality simulation where the Owlks could live forever.

name: Frontier
description: The Frontier was the starting ship given to members of Constellation. A versatile exploration vessel, it was the first step on every spacefarer's journey in the Settled Systems.

name: The Eye
description: The Eye was Constellation's space station dedicated to deep space observation. It served as a hub for the organization's exploration efforts throughout the Settled Systems.

name: The Key
description: The Key was the Crimson Fleet's space station and headquarters. A former United Colonies facility, it became the center of pirate operations in the Kryx system.
